svg.title: What happens when one invoice is processed
svg.desc: Ten numbered steps showing which part of the program calls which: the caller, LangGraph, the step functions, the OpenAI API and the validation code, including the retry loop.
svg.text: What happens when one invoice is processed
Read top to bottom. Each arrow is a function call; the grey text says what comes back or what is added to the state.
adds parsed (the text of the file)
answer: charges and total as raw text
text to numbers, sums checked, hint built
hint set and attempts <= 2: back to step 6
Steps 6 and 7 only repeat when step 8 found a TOTAL_MISMATCH. Otherwise step 9 ends the run.
